facts.text: From around 31 BBY, Kuat and Rothana were secretly contracted by the Kaminoans to develop new vehicles for the Galactic Republic's new clone army.

evidence.quote: From around 31 BBY, Kuat and Rothana were secretly contracted by the Kaminoans to develop new vehicles for the Galactic Republic's new clone army.

facts.text: RHE designed a number of new vehicles, with the Acclamator-class assault ship being the company's first starcraft and the All Terrain Tactical Enforcer being inspired by Rothana's arctic horny whelmers.

evidence.quote: RHE designed a number of new vehicles, with the Acclamator-class assault ship being the company's first starcraft and the All Terrain Tactical Enforcer being inspired by Rothana's arctic horny whelmers.

facts.text: These vehicles made their debut at the outbreak of the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance in 22 BBY.

evidence.quote: These vehicles made their debut at the outbreak of the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance in 22 BBY.

facts.text: After the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, Rothana continued to contribute to the Galactic Empire, the Republic's successor, but was a shadow of its former self and began to specialize in ground vehicle production primarily.

evidence.quote: After the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, Rothana continued to contribute to the Galactic Empire, the Republic's successor, but was a shadow of its former self and began to specialize in ground vehicle production primarily.

facts.text: The world continued to contribute to the Imperial Military's war efforts, including against a rebel cell in 14 BBY.

evidence.quote: The world continued to contribute to the Imperial Military's war efforts, including against a rebel cell in 14 BBY.

facts.text: The Rebel Alliance against the Empire considered Rothana's Imperial facilities as a possible target in 3 ABY.

evidence.quote: The Rebel Alliance against the Empire considered Rothana's Imperial facilities as a possible target in 3 ABY.

facts.text: In 5 ABY, all Imperial personnel on Rothana were redirected to the planet Jakku, where the Empire met its demise.

evidence.quote: In 5 ABY, all Imperial personnel on Rothana were redirected to the planet Jakku, where the Empire met its demise.

facts.text: After the Empire's fall, Rothana's shipyards remained abandoned until a salvager crew infiltrated the facility with the help of one of its former security, the ex-stormtrooper Terex.

evidence.quote: After the Empire's fall, Rothana's shipyards remained abandoned until a salvager crew infiltrated the facility with the help of one of its former security, the ex-stormtrooper Terex.

facts.text: The crew stole an array of abandoned Imperial ships, including the mothballed corvette known as the Carrion Spike.

evidence.quote: The crew stole an array of abandoned Imperial ships, including the mothballed corvette known as the Carrion Spike.

facts.text: A primarily arctic world with mineral-rich soil, Rothana appeared orange-brown from above.

evidence.quote: A primarily arctic world with mineral-rich soil, Rothana appeared orange-brown from above.

facts.text: The arctic regions of the world included icy cliffs and strong wind gusts.

evidence.quote: The arctic regions of the world included icy cliffs and strong wind gusts.

facts.text: The world was home to the arctic horny whelmer, a ten-legged creature found in Rothana's arctic regions that hunted in packs, wearing their prey out with persistence.

evidence.quote: The world was home to the arctic horny whelmer, a ten-legged creature found in Rothana's arctic regions that hunted in packs, wearing their prey out with persistence.

facts.text: Over the years, RHE was among a number of technology companies in the galaxy that were developing gravitational manipulation technology, and the company was developing walker vehicles by the High Republic Era.

evidence.quote: Over the years, RHE was among a number of technology companies in the galaxy that were developing gravitational manipulation technology, and the company was developing walker vehicles by the High Republic Era.

facts.text: One experimental walker was sent from Rothana to the Republic Fair on the planet Valo in 231 BBY, where many different cultural and technological marvels were brought to display from across the galaxy.
entities: The High Republic: The Rising Storm

evidence.quote: One experimental walker was sent from Rothana to the Republic Fair on the planet Valo in 231 BBY, where many different cultural and technological marvels were brought to display from across the galaxy.

facts.text: The walker was used as cover by some dignitaries, including Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic, when the Nihil marauders attacked the fair, but it was eventually destroyed by the attackers, injuring some of the dignitaries.

evidence.quote: The walker was used as cover by some dignitaries, including Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic, when the Nihil marauders attacked the fair, but it was eventually destroyed by the attackers, injuring some of the dignitaries.

facts.text: The walker's part in the attack was mentioned in the fourth chapter of Jedi Master Harli Cogra's Chronicles of the Jedi publication in 229 BBY.
